observations: Recall 22/24 (91.7 %) on every pass, trap resistance 21/23; both misses are population gaps (attributes are not read; projection folds are not folds to ES1).
Both traps caught are classification errors upstream of the rule: a child entity with behaviour is taken for an aggregate root (DM1), and an integration event is taken for a persisted event (ES3).

ED5 offline is a candidate list, not a verdict: 9 of 10 notes in the contained pass were guarded handlers; the model pass cleared 8 of them and confirmed the planted one plus a real concurrency gap (fixed).

DM7 started reporting the four aggregate-root repository implementations as repositories for non-root entities after the infrastructure project gained the EF design-time package and migrations, in both modes; nothing in the domain types changed.
The model-judged pass is not reproducible run to run: D19 changed claim between iterations 2 and 3 and an M4 row appeared only in iteration 3; theme results were identical.

Brief items with no taxonomy concept were not labelled: value objects with identity equality or mutable state, a domain event raised but never handled (ExtendLoanEvent is raised and never mapped), and an event-schema change without an upcaster.

v1.1.0 (key 1.1.0): + VOM-001, DEH-001, DEH-002, ESC-001, BTL-001, BTL-002 (must-fire) and TRP-024 … TRP-027 (must-not-fire); recall 22/30 (73.3 %) on both passes, trap resistance 25/27. The two v1.0.0 misses (DM6-001, ES1-002) and the two caught traps (TRP-002, TRP-022) are unchanged.

The three new concepts are unmapped for Watchdog: their four plants are FNs by construction and their three traps TNs; no existing rule (DM5, ES2, ED5, DM*, D*) reacted to the new value object, events, serializer or handler, in either pass.

D23 attributes bounded contexts per .NET project without configuration, and it DID report both boundary leaks (BTL-001, BTL-002) — but every D23 row is location-less, so they match no located plant, and with boundary-type-leakage now covered the ~60 same-context D23 rows (one context's domain and application projects counted as two contexts) become noise (noise 16 → 79 in the contained pass). A harness mechanism to place D23 rows (the message names the type and member, not a file) or a located D23 row would turn BTL-001/002 into TPs and the false rows into clean-region FPs.
DEH-002 and BTL-002 label v1.0.0 code: both defects existed at v1.0.0 but had no concept in the key (the v1.0.0 observation already named the unhandled-event fact); v1.1.0's truthful key must say so.
